blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 130 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 2, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: XLY & CRL lead 130 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 32 Canadian and 98 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 2, 2026) found 130 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 32 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 16 of them new to the list this week. Auxly Cannabis Group Inc. (XLY) leads with a +99% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 15 names.

In the U.S., 98 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 45 of them new to the list this week. Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (CRL) leads with a +86% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 25 names.
